title: Jubilant Sweet Mediterranean Filo Pastry Pie
description: A sweet and savory Mediterranean dish featuring filo pastry, with a hint of mustard and a bouncy texture, perfect for a cozy evening, this pie is filled with candy and Mediterranean-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the filo pastry and cut it into large squares.
In a bowl, mix together the honey, mustard, and olive oil.
Brush the honey mixture onto the filo pastry squares.
Sprinkle the chopped candy, crumbly feta cheese, salt, and pepper onto the pastry squares.
Fold the pastry squares into triangles and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the pastry triangles with olive oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Place the pastry triangles on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the pastry triangles in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
